title: ID0481262-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/PN 312561850/06] Charging session stopped
description:

additional_info.body:
Dear
Florent
,
Following up on your ticket request, after our checks we can confirm that the charging session failed under
Charging Phase "P06_CHARGE" --> "P00_UNKNOWN"
status. As shown in the attached screenshot, this issue is related to a lost ECOG connection. Our team is currently working on fixing this problem in the new firmware version. Therefore, we will proceed with closing the ticket.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
